title.en: Which machine mixes and pumps a self-built pour on the grid?
title.zh: 有电网时，哪台机器能又搅拌又泵送自建浇筑？

description.en: The Integrated Mixer Pump: 45 kW plus 14 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, 100 m / 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below. It is not a mixing plant.
description.zh: 搅拌泵一体机：45 kW 加 14 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、100 m / 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下。它不是搅拌站。

h1.en: Which machine mixes and pumps a self-built pour on the grid?
h1.zh: 有电网时，哪台机器能又搅拌又泵送自建浇筑？

directAnswer.en: The electric Integrated Mixer Pump, when the site can feed it. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints rural and self-built house pouring on this machine, together with “mix and pump in one unit”: main motor 45 kW, mixer motor 14 kW, 21 m³/h, 23 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 100 m / 300 m, aggregate 4 cm and below, pipe 100 / 125 mm and 4500 kg. The category text says it is not a concrete mixing plant.
directAnswer.zh: 现场供得起电时，用电动搅拌泵一体机。邢台河北品锦机械在这台机器上印了农村与自建房浇筑，以及“搅拌与泵送一体”：主电机 45 kW、搅拌电机 14 kW、21 m³/h、23 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、100 m / 300 m、骨料 4 cm 及以下、管径 100 / 125 mm、4500 kg。分类说明写明它不是混凝土搅拌站。

heading.en: 4500 kg is not a compact rural pump

body.en: Electric 15 is 450 kg. The rural diesel is 800 kg. This mixer pump is a 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm unit. Use it when the job really is mixing and pumping together and the pipe fits 100 m / 300 m. A short secondary-structure line that only needs placement stays on the compact pumps.
body.zh: 电动15是 450 kg。农村柴油泵是 800 kg。这台搅拌泵是 3900 × 1500 × 1600 mm 的设备。作业确实要同时搅拌和泵送，并且管路落在 100 m / 300 m 内时才用它。只需要浇筑的短二次结构管路，留在紧凑泵上。

heading.en: The series note does not add unpublished models
heading.zh: 系列说明不会多出未公布的型号

body.en: The page notes “30 series with 400 mixer; 40/50 series with 500 mixer.” This application uses the printed 45 kW / 14 kW and 21 m³/h row. It does not split new performance numbers for those series names. Off-grid mixing and pumping is the diesel mixer, not this electric unit.
body.zh: 页面注明“30 系列配 400 搅拌，40/50 系列配 500 搅拌”。本应用使用已印的 45 kW / 14 kW 和 21 m³/h 这一行。不为那些系列名称另拆性能数字。无电网的搅拌加泵送是柴油搅拌泵，不是这台电机型。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Say the site must mix and pump, and confirm power for 45 kW plus 14 kW. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请说明现场必须搅拌并泵送，并确认能供给 45 kW 加 14 kW。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

answer.en: No. The cell is 100 m / 300 m, horizontal / vertical.
answer.zh: 不是。格子是水平/垂直 100 m / 300 m。

question.en: Does 4 cm aggregate apply to Electric 15?
question.zh: 4 cm 骨料适用于电动15吗？

answer.en: No. Electric 15 prints 1–3 cm. 4 cm and below is this mixer pump’s cell.
answer.zh: 不适用。电动15印的是 1–3 cm。4 cm 及以下是这台搅拌泵的格子。
